## Overview

TVBO provides built-in plotting functions for common visualization tasks:
time series, network graphs, connectivity matrices, phase portraits,
bifurcation diagrams, and functional connectivity.

## Time Series

```python
result = exp.run()
result.plot()
```

## Network Visualization

```python
net.plot_graph()      # Force-directed graph
net.plot_matrix()     # Connectivity matrix heatmap
```
